Search and Filter Submitted Case Codings Across Scales

Source: R/utils_db.R
search_case_codings_db.Rd

Queries user_ratings joined with texts, scale_definitions, user_tokens, and sources to allow administrators to locate specific case ratings by scale, rating type (kodierung, gold_standard, schulung), case ID, text excerpt, or coder username.

Usage

search_case_codings_db(
  con,
  scale_filter = "all",
  type_filter = "all",
  search_query = ""
)

Arguments

con

A DBIConnection or pool::dbPool object representing the active database connection.

scale_filter

Character string specifying either "all" or a target scale_id (or scale name/short label). Defaults to "all".

type_filter

Character string specifying either "all" or one of "kodierung", "gold_standard", "schulung". Defaults to "all".

search_query

Optional character string used to filter results across rating ID, text ID, case text content, coder username, and scale labels. Defaults to "".

Value

A data.frame containing matching rating records ordered by rating_id DESC, including resolved scale metadata (resolved_scale_id, scale_name, scale_short_label, scale_max_value) and case context.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
results <- search_case_codings_db(con, scale_filter = "1",
  type_filter = "kodierung", search_query = "101")
} # }
